newsitem.title: USA: ARM Financial boosts IPO terms nearly 40 percent.
newsitem.headline: ARM Financial boosts IPO terms nearly 40 percent.

text.p: Asset management group ARM Financial Group has increased the size of its initial public offering by 38.6 percent, according to lead underwriter Morgan Stanley Co.

The company will sell eight million shares for $14 to $16 each, up from an earlier estimate of 5.75 million shares at $12 to $14 each. That brings total proceeds to about $104 million, up from roughly $75 million.
IPO analysts say the deal looks hot and could rise a few points at its market debut, due Friday. Manish Shah, editor of the IPO Maven, has said the deal is four times oversubscribed.
